name: Block The Seed
body:
School abjuration; Level bard 1, cleric 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, hedge witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a piece of citrus peel or a drop of citrus juice)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 day/level

DESCRIPTION

For the spell’s duration, you are incapable of becoming pregnant, or impregnating someone else. This spell provides no protection against diseases.

While this is a personal-effect spell, many hedge witches brew potions of block the seed for others.
